label: The incremental cost-effectiveness ratio equals the difference in cost between two strategies divided by the difference in their effect, such as QALYs gained
The present value of a stream of costs equals the sum over each time period of that period's cost divided by one plus the discount rate, raised to the period number
Quality-adjusted life years equals the sum over each time period of the utility in that period multiplied by the length of time spent in it
The incremental net monetary benefit equals the willingness-to-pay per unit of effect times the incremental effect, minus the incremental cost
